description: The bar chart, titled "Average performance on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests," compares the average scores of various language models on a standardized test, with the score representing the average temperature (in degrees Celsius) and scaled to a maximum of 0.5. The horizontal axis lists the models, including 70b, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-instruct, GPT 4o, GPT 4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72b-instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4. The vertical axis ranges from 60 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each model, two bars are displayed: a light blue bar representing the "Large model" and a dark blue bar representing the "Small model." The chart shows that phi-4 achieves the highest performance with an average score of 91.8 for the small model and 89.8 for the large model, while the 70b model has the lowest performance with scores of 66.4 for the large model and 66.4 for the small model. The performance generally increases across the models from left to right, with the small model consistently outperforming the large model in all cases.
